stem: Which action did Dr. King recommend for achieving the “new frontier” described in this excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: Making efforts to peacefully integrate people of different backgrounds

options.label: B
options.text: Petitioning to permanently close segregated businesses and facilities

options.label: C
options.text: Avoiding disagreements with supporters of segregation

options.label: D
options.text: Relocating to states where integration was less common

visual_elements:
And so, many bright [intelligent] young men and women . . . realize that the new frontier will be “integration” rather than “desegregation” and that this makes quite a difference.

—Martin Luther King, Jr., “After Desegregation—What,” April 27, 1961
